import sys,json,os,time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

CAMS=['robot0_agentview_center','robot0_agentview_left','robot0_agentview_right','robot0_eye_in_hand']

def save_obs(res,tag):
    root='/app/output/'+tag
    os.makedirs(root,exist_ok=True)
    with open(root+'/meta.json','w') as f: json.dump(res.meta,f,indent=2,default=str)
    for k,v in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(v).save(root+'/'+k+'.png')
    for k,v in res.depth.items(): np.save(root+'/'+k+'.npy',v)
    p=dict(zip(res.meta['proprio']['layout'],res.meta['proprio']['now']))
    print(tag,'steps',res.meta['control_steps'],'time_left',round(res.meta['time_left_s'],1),'eef',*[round(p['eef_right_'+x],3) for x in 'xyz'],'base',*[round(p['mobilebase0_joint_mobile_'+x+'_pos'],3) for x in ['forward','side','yaw']],'torso',round(p['mobilebase0_joint_torso_height_pos'],3),'grip',*[round(p['gripper0_right_finger_joint'+str(i)+'_pos'],3) for i in [1,2]],flush=True)
    return p

def act(row,n,tag,cams=CAMS,video='none'):
    r=Robot()
    a=np.tile(np.array(row,dtype=float),(n,1))
    o=r.submit('ee_delta',a,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video=video,interpolate='hold')
    save_obs(o,tag)
    return o

if __name__=='__main__':
    if sys.argv[1]=='obs':
        r=Robot();o=r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS,include_depth=True,video='none');save_obs(o,sys.argv[2])
    if sys.argv[1]=='act':
        row=json.loads(sys.argv[2]);act(row,int(sys.argv[3]),sys.argv[4])
PY
